title: BaseWars
description: A Minecraft plugin that allows players to build and defend custom bases with hoppers as core structures. Features include territory protection, base upgrades, health systems, and interactive management cards.
body:
A **Minecraft plugin** that lets you build and protect your own custom bases. 
Place a hopper as your base core, then construct any structure around it. 
Your base has health points and can be upgraded to higher levels using 
diamonds, iron, and gold. Each base protects a 10-block radius from other 
players and requires at least 50 blocks distance from other bases. Manage 
your base through an interactive card item that shows stats, upgrade 
requirements, and lets you customize the base name. Defend your territory 
or attack enemy bases in strategic PvP combat!
